neutral.name: Miscellaneous Room
neutral.description: An enclosed space with plenty of potential and no dedicated use.
neutral.tooltip: This area has walls and doors but no dedicated use

latrine.name: Latrine
latrine.description:
It's a step up from doing one's business in full view of the rest of the colony.

Using a toilet in an enclosed room will improve Duplicants' Morale.
latrine.tooltip: Using a toilet in an enclosed room will improve Duplicants' Morale

plumbedbathroom.name: Washroom
plumbedbathroom.description:
A sanctuary of personal hygiene.

Using a fully plumbed Washroom will improve Duplicants' Morale.
plumbedbathroom.tooltip: Using a fully plumbed Washroom will improve Duplicants' Morale

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.description:
A basic communal sleeping area for up-and-coming colonies.

Sleeping in Barracks will improve Duplicants' Morale.
barracks.tooltip: Sleeping in Barracks will improve Duplicants' Morale

bedroom.name: Luxury Barracks
bedroom.description:
An upscale communal sleeping area full of things that greatly enhance quality of rest for occupants.

Sleeping in a Luxury Barracks will improve Duplicants' Morale.
bedroom.tooltip: Sleeping in a Luxury Barracks will improve Duplicants' Morale

private_bedroom.name: Private Bedroom
private_bedroom.description:
A comfortable, roommate-free retreat where tired Duplicants can get uninterrupted rest.

Sleeping in a Private Bedroom will greatly improve Duplicants' Morale.
private_bedroom.tooltip: Sleeping in a Private Bedroom will greatly improve Duplicants' Morale

messhall.name: Mess Hall
messhall.description:
A simple dining room setup that's easy to improve upon.

Eating at a mess table in a Mess Hall will increase Duplicants' Morale.
messhall.tooltip: Eating at a Mess Table in a Mess Hall will improve Duplicants' Morale

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description:
A cooking area equipped to take meals to the next level.

Adding ingredients from a Spice Grinder to foods cooked on an Electric Grill or Gas Range provides a variety of positive benefits.
kitchen.tooltip: Using a Spice Grinder in a Kitchen adds benefits to foods cooked on Electric Grill or Gas Range

greathall.name: Great Hall
greathall.description:
A great place to eat, with great decor. Great!

Eating in a Great Hall will improve Duplicants' Morale.
greathall.tooltip: Eating in a Great Hall will significantly improve Duplicants' Morale

banquethall.name: Banquet Hall
banquethall.description:
An exquisite place for communal dining.

Eating in a Banquet Hall will dramatically improve Duplicants' Morale.
banquethall.tooltip: Eating in a Banquet Hall will dramatically improve Duplicants' Morale

hospital.name: Hospital
hospital.description:
A dedicated medical facility that helps minimize recovery time.

Sick Duplicants assigned to medical buildings located within a Hospital are also less likely to spread Disease.
hospital.tooltip: Sick Duplicants assigned to medical buildings located within a Hospital are less likely to spread Disease

massage_clinic.name: Massage Clinic
massage_clinic.description:
A soothing space with a very relaxing ambience, especially when well-decorated.

Receiving massages at a Massage Clinic will significantly improve Stress reduction.
massage_clinic.tooltip: Receiving massages at a Massage Clinic will significantly improve Stress reduction

power_plant.name: Power Plant
power_plant.description:
The perfect place for Duplicants to flex their Electrical Engineering skills.

Heavy-duty generators built within a Power Plant can be tuned up using microchips from power control stations to improve their Power production.
power_plant.effect: - Enables Microchip tune-ups on heavy-duty generators
power_plant.tooltip: Heavy-duty generators built in a Power Plant can be tuned up using microchips from Power Control Stations to improve their Power production

machine_shop.name: Machine Shop
machine_shop.description:
It smells like elbow grease.

Duplicants working in a Machine Shop can maintain buildings and increase their production speed.
machine_shop.tooltip: Duplicants working in a Machine Shop can maintain buildings and increase their production speed

farm.name: Greenhouse
farm.description:
An enclosed agricultural space best utilized by Duplicants with Crop Tending skills.

Crops grown within a Greenhouse can be tended with Farm Station fertilizer to increase their growth speed.
farm.tooltip: Crops grown within a Greenhouse can be tended with Farm Station fertilizer to increase their growth speed

creaturepen.name: Stable
creaturepen.description:
Critters don't mind it here, as long as things don't get too crowded.

Stabled critters can be tended to in order to improve their happiness, hasten their domestication and increase their production.

Enables the use of Grooming Stations, Shearing Stations, Critter Condos, Critter Fountains and Milking Stations.
creaturepen.tooltip: A stable enables Grooming Station, Critter Condo, Critter Fountain, Shearing Station and Milking Station use

rec_room.name: Recreation Room
rec_room.description:
Where Duplicants go to mingle with off-duty peers and indulge in a little R&R.

Scheduled Downtime will further improve Morale for Duplicants visiting a Recreation Room.
rec_room.tooltip: Scheduled Downtime will further improve Morale for Duplicants visiting a Recreation Room

park.name: Park
park.description:
A little greenery goes a long way.

Passing through natural spaces throughout the day will raise the Morale of Duplicants.
park.tooltip: Passing through natural spaces throughout the day will raise the Morale of Duplicants

naturereserve.name: Nature Reserve
naturereserve.description:
A lot of greenery goes an even longer way.

Passing through a Nature Reserve will grant higher Morale bonuses to Duplicants than a Park.
naturereserve.tooltip: A Nature Reserve will grant higher Morale bonuses to Duplicants than a Park

laboratory.name: Laboratory
laboratory.description:
Where wild hypotheses meet rigorous scientific experimentation.

Science stations built in a Laboratory function more efficiently.

A Laboratory enables the use of the Geotuner and the Mission Control Station.
laboratory.tooltip:
Science buildings built in a Laboratory function more efficiently

A Laboratory enables Geotuner and Mission Control Station use

private_bathroom.name: Private Bathroom
private_bathroom.description:
Finally, a place to truly be alone with one's thoughts.

Duplicants relieve even more Stress when using the toilet in a Private Bathroom than in a Latrine.
private_bathroom.tooltip: Duplicants relieve even more stress when using the toilet in a Private Bathroom than in a Latrine
